finalText:
**Redis died and took the service with it.**

At `02:14:07` `[api]` lost Redis: `connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. A cache miss storm on `orders:*` keys overloaded the store. Every read then hit `TimeoutError: request timed out after 5000ms`. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 past the 500 max. All 13 reconnect tries failed. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` and died code 134. `[supervisor]` killed the group at `02:31:52`.

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back. Check it first. Note the log is dated `2026-07-04`, not last night.
